svg.title: Proposed physical C0 and C1 connectors for the eight orange tiles
svg.text: Orange tiles — proposed C0 / C1 connector shapes
Ordinary circle/plus signals stay the same. The last output uses a distinct centre-state connector.
Eight directed tile types · input (x, y, y, z) → three packed bits + C_y
The same rectangular piece is used horizontally, then rotated 90° for the second pass.
C0 and C1 fit neither ordinary input profile, so the next orange layer cannot cover the C column.
Proposed dimensions: body 4L/5 × L/5; connector pitch L/5. C profiles are symmetric under 90° turns.
Profile proposal only. The C-channel height and final-layer reach-down connection remain to be designed.
